parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.7, the two methods belong to distinct test classes (`AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.stopTransitionsToIdle` at line 71 and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests.playAfterStopWorks` at line 164) and are intentionally testing different behavioral concerns — state transition to idle vs. idempotency of play-after-stop. Structural similarity in test helpers or assertion patterns is expected and does not warrant extraction. Merging or abstracting these would obscure the distinct test intent and reduce readability of the test suite.
